name: blinding gaze
desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=B6xM8C2pABIb5o7y]], one creature the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=B6xM8C2pABIb5o7y]] feet. Failure: The target has the &Reference[Blinded apply=false] condition for 1 minute. Failure or Success: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.
